::: {.column width="80%"}
- Inter-community inspiration and exchange of knowledge

- Strengthen collaboration between users, empiricists, model developers, and software developers

- Translation of researcher needs into digital infrastructure (e.g., for future grant proposals, sustainable practices)

- Articles on individual research questions developed during the workshop, focussing on reconstructing phylogenies incorporating fossil and rock information
